title: Delete users sequentially in the nightly purge

source.note: Written by the repository author for the v0.4.0 follow-up (tempting-correct repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: The nightly user purge fails every night: the identity provider rejects parallel admin calls with 429 and locks the client out for 60 seconds.
constraints: Provider rule (documented by the vendor): at most ONE in-flight admin request per client; a second concurrent request triggers a 60 s lockout.
The purge handles at most ~300 ids per night and has a 2-hour window.
input.context: Node.js 20 batch job (ESM, JSDoc). Each delete takes ~150 ms, so 300 sequential deletes take under a minute.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: 'await in a loop is slow, use Promise.all / p-limit / batching' advice, although the provider allows exactly one in-flight request and throughput is irrelevant.
